task.name: Secure_equipment_truck_and_container
task.when: After post-event equipment has been returned

step.action: Inspect the equipment-truck doorway for an object blocking closure.
step.ifThen: IF an object blocks the door, THEN ask its owner or the Dominatrix where it belongs.

step.action: Inspect the storage-container doorway for an object blocking closure.
step.ifThen: IF an object blocks the door, THEN ask its owner or the Dominatrix where it belongs.

passWhen.criterion: The equipment-truck door is closed and latched.
The storage-container door is closed and latched.
